details.report: Repaired the root cause: validateStatsLineV1 now validates each metric's closed measured payload and metric-specific unavailable state instead of accepting any outer Metric union. It enforces nonnegative safe integers, exact role totals/nested keys, ordered valid timestamps, exact merge milliseconds, byte-ratio denominator/value consistency, and lawful per-metric reasons while preserving current producer facts and honest unavailable outputs. Added table-driven red/green coverage for malformed types, negatives, fractions, overflow, extra keys, timestamps, totals, ratios, and cross-metric reasons; added a Doctor intake regression proving malformed StatsLines are not admitted as validated. Regenerated dist/stats-line.js. No findings were declined. Verification passed: focused StatsLine/Doctor tests (9/9), typecheck, isolated-HOME full suite (349 tests: 344 pass, 5 skipped), npm pack dry-run, explicit tarball cold install/import, and git diff check. Forward commit fb4ebe0a0ca9971d3c337d3476b30b9b9486280b.
